limits: Signed in locally, created an empty Cycle class, and imported the mock catalog track Titanium. A local D1 row granted Spotify streaming scope so the preview control could start. That row is not in git.
Before Play, the page set window.Spotify.Player to throw new Error('') and, on a later load, { code: 1 }. The real Web Playback SDK did not run. No provider audio.

new Error('') showed Something went wrong. in the preview alert at 1440 and 390. The non-Error showed Could not start "Titanium". at 390 and 1440. No role=alert was blank. documentElement.scrollWidth matched the viewport at both widths. No page errors.
No real device or screen-reader acceptance.
